_comment: A populated console snapshot, in the exact shape consoleSnapshot() in src/state.ts emits. Invented content for rendering only. Six live tables across every TableStatus, one waiting group, one archived table, candidates in every state the console shows.

sessions.name: Afternoon: Who decides
sessions.summary:
## Afternoon

- Tables agreed early that **accountability** has to sit with a named person.

> "If the model is wrong, someone has to own the apology."

tables.name: Table 1
questions: Which task in your week would you hand off first?
What would you refuse to hand off?
tables.summary: Arguing that the first thing to automate is scheduling, not judgement. One strong dissent from a nurse manager on shift handover.

quotes.text: Handover is where the patient lives or dies. Nobody is automating that.

flags.text: Who is liable when the handoff summary is wrong?

board.synthesis: Automate the logistics around care, never the moment care changes hands.

tables.name: Table 2
tables.summary: Three people keep returning to whether junior roles disappear. Same point, rephrased.

tables.name: Table 3
tables.summary: Landed on apprenticeship as the answer to the junior-role problem; drafting a one-line recommendation.

board.synthesis: Replace the entry-level job with a paid apprenticeship.

tables.name: Ops & Finance
tables.summary: Pricing AI work by outcome rather than by hour. Disagreement over who carries the risk.

tables.name: Table 6
tables.summary: Trust in vendor claims. Nobody at the table has seen an eval they believed.

waitingSessions.name: Table 7
questions: What would make you trust an AI teammate?

candidates.topic: THE JUNIOR ROLE BECOMES AN APPRENTICESHIP
candidates.rationale: Tables 2 and 3 independently arrived at replacing entry-level work with structured training.

evidence.quote: If the grunt work goes, the training has to be on purpose now, not by accident.
Where does the next senior engineer come from if nobody is junior?

candidates.rationale: Tables 1 and 6 both drew the line at the moment responsibility changes hands.

evidence.quote: Handover is where the patient lives or dies. Nobody is automating that.

candidates.rationale: Ops & Finance and Table 6 converged on outcome pricing.
